holderQuote: There was a slight rumble and increased traction as the wheels met solid earth again. Now they were on a straightaway headed through some flat, lovely, open plains. Reynold could have cried in relief. He turned, and nearly jumped out of his skin as he saw Ressa standing next to him. The [Maid] had climbed out of the carriage’s door and to the front without him hearing a thing.
